title: Import replaces state and changes credential binding
when: Before importing an archive into a local, self-hosted or hosted destination
need: Save a backup of destination data you need, then choose its mode-specific route. On a fresh selected local universe, run yoke universe import ARCHIVE; copied API tokens and browser sessions are revoked and the machine owner becomes admin. For a self-hosted bundle, stop the destination core service, then run yoke self-host import ARCHIVE --dir BUNDLE; copied tokens and sessions are revoked and one fresh admin token is shown once. Use that token to connect to the destination. For a hosted destination, use Import in Universe portability, then reconnect clients and sign in through destination authority because copied credentials have been revoked. Prepare repository folders, external services and machine-local secrets separately.
surface: Mode-specific import help and Universe portability controls; portability guide.
